## Instructions for the AI agent

Add Stat & metric to this project exactly as specified here.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Components it uses.** None: Stat & metric only needs the files below.
3. **Create the files.** Create every file under [Files](#files) at its exact path, with exactly the contents shown. If you can run shell commands, the download script below does this in one go.
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/chart.css";
   @import "./components/stat.css";
   ```

5. **Usage example only.** The example also renders this component; install it if you use the example as-is (the download script and the CSS lines above include it):
   - `chart`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/chart.md
6. **Use it.** `import { Stat, StatChart, StatDelta, StatGroup, … } from '@/ui/components/stat';` See [Usage](#usage). Tell the user which files you created.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Component: Stat & metric

A number with context: label, large value, trend delta, help text and an optional sparkline. Presentational and Server Component–safe.

#### Anatomy
```
<StatGroup variant>            .ui-stat-group > .ui-stat-group-grid (auto-fit grid)
  <Stat>                       .ui-stat (flex column, gap 4px, padding 20px)
    <StatLabel />              <p class="ui-stat-label">
    <StatValue />              <div class="ui-stat-value">
    <StatDelta />              .ui-stat-delta[data-tone][data-direction]
    <StatHelp />               <p class="ui-stat-help">
    <StatChart />              .ui-stat-chart (32px) — put a <Sparkline> here
```

#### Props
- `StatGroup`: `variant` (`separate` default | `shared`), `minItemWidth` (default `13rem`).
- `StatDelta`: `value` (pre-formatted), `direction` (`up` | `down` | `flat`), `tone` (`positive` | `negative` | `neutral`; defaults from direction — set it when down is good), `comparison` ("vs last month").

#### Visual rules
- Label 14px / 500 `--ui-muted-foreground`. Value 28px / 500, tracking −0.02em, `tabular-nums`, nowrap, `--ui-foreground`.
- Delta 14px / 500: arrow icon 14px + value, tone colour `--ui-success-text` (positive) / `--ui-destructive-text` (negative) / muted (neutral). Comparison text muted, regular weight.
- Help text 12px muted. Chart slot 32px tall, 12px above.
- `separate`: each Stat is a card (1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-lg`, `--ui-surface`), 16px gap.
- `shared`: one surface with the group border and `--radius-lg`; hairlines between cells (right and bottom edges, clipped so the outer border stays single).
- A bare `Stat` has no surface so it can sit inside a Card.

#### Motion
- None built in; wrap in `ui-stagger` for a soft-rise entrance, or use AnimatedNumber for the value.

#### Accessibility
- The delta carries visually hidden text ("Up", "Down", "No change,") before the value, so colour and arrow are not the only signal. The group has `role="group"`.

#### Acceptance checks
- Four stats fill a desktop row and wrap to 2 then 1 column as the width shrinks, with no horizontal scroll.
- Shared variant: one outer border, single-pixel hairlines, no doubled edges, in light and dark.
- Positive / negative colours pass 4.5:1 on the surface.

### `ui/components/stat/stat.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type CSSProperties, type HTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';

export type StatGroupVariant = 'separate' | 'shared';

export interface StatGroupProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** `separate`: each stat is its own bordered card. `shared`: one bordered surface with hairlines between stats (Stripe-like). Default `separate`. */
  variant?: StatGroupVariant;
  /** Narrowest a stat may get before the grid wraps (CSS length). Default `13rem`. */
  minItemWidth?: string;
}

/**
 * StatGroup — a responsive grid of Stats that wraps by available width.
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const StatGroup = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, StatGroupProps>(function StatGroup(
  { variant = 'separate', minItemWidth, className, style, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const gridStyle = minItemWidth ? ({ '--ui-stat-min': minItemWidth } as CSSProperties) : undefined;
  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      role="group"
      className={cn('ui-stat-group', variant === 'shared' && 'ui-stat-group-shared', className)}
      style={style}
      {...props}
    >
      <div className="ui-stat-group-grid" style={gridStyle}>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

/**
 * Stat — one metric: label, big value, optional delta, help text and chart.
 * Flat by default so it sits inside a Card; StatGroup gives it a surface.
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Stat = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function Stat({ className, ...props }, ref) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-stat', className)} {...props} />;
});

/** What the number measures: "Monthly revenue". */
export const StatLabel = forwardRef<HTMLParagraphElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>>(function StatLabel(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <p ref={ref} className={cn('ui-stat-label', className)} {...props} />;
});

/** The number: large, tabular, never wraps. */
export const StatValue = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function StatValue(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-stat-value', className)} {...props} />;
});

export type StatDirection = 'up' | 'down' | 'flat';
export type StatTone = 'positive' | 'negative' | 'neutral';

export interface StatDeltaProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'children'> {
  /** The change, already formatted: "12.4%", "+$1,240". */
  value: ReactNode;
  /** Arrow direction. Default `up`. */
  direction?: StatDirection;
  /** Colour. Defaults from the direction (up = positive, down = negative); set it when down is good (churn, latency). */
  tone?: StatTone;
  /** Context after the value: "vs last month". */
  comparison?: ReactNode;
}

const DIRECTION_TEXT: Record<StatDirection, string> = { up: 'Up', down: 'Down', flat: 'No change,' };

/** The change since the last period, with an arrow and a success / destructive tone. */
export const StatDelta = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, StatDeltaProps>(function StatDelta(
  { value, direction = 'up', tone, comparison, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const resolved: StatTone = tone ?? (direction === 'up' ? 'positive' : direction === 'down' ? 'negative' : 'neutral');
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-stat-delta', className)} data-tone={resolved} data-direction={direction} {...props}>
      <span className="ui-stat-delta-value">
        {direction !== 'flat' && <Icon name={direction === 'up' ? 'arrow-up' : 'arrow-down'} size={14} strokeWidth={2} />}
        <span className="ui-stat-sr">{DIRECTION_TEXT[direction]} </span>
        {value}
      </span>
      {comparison != null && <span className="ui-stat-delta-comparison">{comparison}</span>}
    </div>
  );
});

/** Quiet supporting text under the value. */
export const StatHelp = forwardRef<HTMLParagraphElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>>(function StatHelp(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <p ref={ref} className={cn('ui-stat-help', className)} {...props} />;
});

/** Slot for a Sparkline (or any small chart) at the bottom of the stat. */
export const StatChart = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function StatChart(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-stat-chart', className)} {...props} />;
});
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/stat.css`

```css
/* Stat & metric -----------------------------------------------------------
   .ui-stat > .ui-stat-label, .ui-stat-value, .ui-stat-delta, .ui-stat-help, .ui-stat-chart
   .ui-stat-delta[data-tone="positive|negative|neutral"][data-direction="up|down|flat"]
   .ui-stat-group > .ui-stat-group-grid > .ui-stat       (+ .ui-stat-group-shared)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-stat {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 1.25rem;
    color: var(--ui-surface-foreground);
  }

  .ui-stat-label {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .ui-stat-value {
    margin-top: 0.25rem;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-3xl);
    line-height: 1.1;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .ui-stat-delta {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.125rem 0.5rem;
    margin-top: 0.25rem;
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    line-height: 1.25rem;
  }
  .ui-stat-delta-value {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.125rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
  }
  .ui-stat-delta[data-tone="positive"] .ui-stat-delta-value { color: var(--ui-success-text); }
  .ui-stat-delta[data-tone="negative"] .ui-stat-delta-value { color: var(--ui-destructive-text); }
  .ui-stat-delta-comparison { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }

  .ui-stat-help {
    margin: 0.25rem 0 0;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: 1.25rem;
  }

  .ui-stat-chart {
    margin-top: 0.75rem;
    height: 2rem;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  /* Announced by screen readers, never seen */
  .ui-stat-sr {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip-path: inset(50%);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* Group: separate cards */
  .ui-stat-group { min-width: 0; }
  .ui-stat-group-grid {
    --ui-stat-min: 13rem;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, var(--ui-stat-min)), 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  .ui-stat-group:not(.ui-stat-group-shared) .ui-stat {
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface);
  }

  /* Group: shared border — one surface, hairlines between cells.
     Each cell draws its right and bottom edge; the grid overhangs the clipped
     container by 1px so the outermost edges disappear under the container border. */
  .ui-stat-group-shared {
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface);
  }
  .ui-stat-group-shared .ui-stat-group-grid {
    gap: 0;
    margin: 0 -1px -1px 0;
  }
  .ui-stat-group-shared .ui-stat {
    box-shadow: 1px 0 0 0 var(--ui-border), 0 1px 0 0 var(--ui-border);
  }
}
```

## Usage

**KPI row with sparklines** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/stat/kpis.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Sparkline } from '@/ui/components/chart';
import { Stat, StatChart, StatDelta, StatGroup, StatLabel, StatValue } from '@/ui/components/stat';

const revenue = [18, 22, 21, 26, 25, 31, 29, 35, 38, 36, 42, 47];
const subscribers = [310, 322, 318, 340, 351, 349, 372, 380, 395, 401, 418, 436];
const churn = [3.1, 3.4, 3.2, 3.0, 2.9, 3.1, 2.8, 2.7, 2.6, 2.7, 2.4, 2.3];
const latency = [212, 198, 205, 190, 201, 188, 176, 182, 170, 168, 160, 154];

export default function StatKpis() {
  return (
    <StatGroup variant="shared" className="w-full" aria-label="Key metrics">
      <Stat>
        <StatLabel>Monthly revenue</StatLabel>
        <StatValue>$47,210</StatValue>
        <StatDelta value="12.4%" direction="up" comparison="vs last month" />
        <StatChart>
          <Sparkline data={revenue} variant="area" height={32} color="series-1" aria-label="Revenue, last 12 months" />
        </StatChart>
      </Stat>
      <Stat>
        <StatLabel>Active subscribers</StatLabel>
        <StatValue>4,360</StatValue>
        <StatDelta value="4.1%" direction="up" comparison="vs last month" />
        <StatChart>
          <Sparkline data={subscribers} height={32} color="series-2" aria-label="Subscribers, last 12 months" />
        </StatChart>
      </Stat>
      <Stat>
        <StatLabel>Churn rate</StatLabel>
        <StatValue>2.3%</StatValue>
        <StatDelta value="0.4 pts" direction="down" tone="positive" comparison="vs last month" />
        <StatChart>
          <Sparkline data={churn} height={32} color="series-3" aria-label="Churn, last 12 months" />
        </StatChart>
      </Stat>
      <Stat>
        <StatLabel>p95 latency</StatLabel>
        <StatValue>154 ms</StatValue>
        <StatDelta value="9.5%" direction="down" tone="positive" comparison="vs last month" />
        <StatChart>
          <Sparkline data={latency} variant="bar" height={32} color="series-4" aria-label="Latency, last 12 months" />
        </StatChart>
      </Stat>
    </StatGroup>
  );
}
```
